steps.content: As you walk towards the stage, you step on something. You bend over to pick it up and find it's a newspaper.
The year is before Nightfall, the headline talks about a play being performed, which has attracted a huge crowd.
Just as you're about to take a closer look, you hear a rush of footsteps on the stage.
The door to the set is pushed open and someone bursts in with a newspaper. The playwright sitting by the window looks up.

steps.speaker: Assistant
steps.content: Sir! Sir! You've made the headlines!

steps.speaker: Assistant
steps.content: Listen to this review... "The play 'After Nightfall' showcases extraordinary imagination and creativity. The protagonist, known as Chief, is groundbreakingly..."

steps.speaker: Assistant
steps.content: "...Indeed, 'After Nightfall' signifies the maturity of the theatre industry! In the future, it will undoubtedly become a gem in theatrical history!"

steps.speaker: Playwright
steps.content: Let me see!
The playwright snatches the newspaper, his lips and eyebrows trembling.

steps.speaker: Playwright
steps.content: I've made it... I've finally made it!!

steps.speaker: Playwright
steps.content: I made a masterpiece... I'm a great playwright...
The playwright wipes away tears, bouncing around the room like an immature student.

steps.speaker: Assistant
steps.content: You're truly amazing... "Mania" "MBCC" "Chief"... It's all so interesting... How did you come up with such a world...
The playwright modestly touches his head.

steps.speaker: Playwright
steps.content: Cough, I just had a dream like this one day...

steps.speaker: Playwright
steps.content: I also dreamed... I was a student in the future world, no matter how I tried, I couldn't get into the art school... In the end, I had no choice but to set up an array in the theatre to pray to the ancestors.

steps.speaker: Assistant
steps.content: Oh my, how could you possibly be such a nobody!
On stage, the assistant continues to flatter the playwright. Off stage, Ignis tries to keep a straight face, but her shoulders can't stop shaking... She waves the newspaper, signaling you to look.
"Interpretation of the role of Chief..." "Exclusive Interview! Why did █ █ design the Chief role?" "MBCC's Chief kindles theatre passion!"
You look at the newspaper, then at the stage, turn your head to look at Ignis, point at yourself...
